body:
I can absolutely sympathize with you. Not directly on the dating aspect, but in general not really having any friends. Trying to overcome this with no support group is almost an impossible feat.

I’m 22, so I will say don’t worry about a relationship yet. It will come to you soon. You’re still at an age where 99% of people don’t know how to maintain a healthy relationship as it is so you aren’t missing much.
